evidence: Memory recall worked (fetched 3 context items from project-neonpath and factory banks), but Hindsight memory banks lack project-specific incident data. Banks returned generic Factory run notes about LiteLLM/vLLM validation instead of project-neonpath failure patterns because the memory ingestion pipeline that backfills historical incident repairs has never been run for this project. Previous investigation identified codex app-server timeouts as a secondary contributor to failed experimental runs.
attemptsReviewed: Two prior Cezar investigation runs classified the failure as environment with high confidence. First attributed empty recall to unpopulated banks; second attributed run failures to codex infrastructure timeouts. Both correctly recommended returning to planning rather than blocking.
rootCauseHypothesis: The project-neonpath Hindsight memory bank has not been populated with historical incident summaries. The memory ingestion pipeline that writes compact redacted incident summaries (first-seen/resolved/reopened) to project-specific banks has never executed for this project. Without this data, recall returns generic Factory notes rather than project-specific repair patterns.
recommendedAction: Implement the Hindsight memory adapter (Issue #55) first - bounded outbox, redaction, idempotency, bank isolation. Then run the ingestion pipeline to backfill historical incidents from project issue history. Do not treat memory bank population as a blocker; it is an operational data-population task, not a missing dependency.
